theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.title: French Protests Taper Off as Officials Admit Failure
top_news.summary: French officials have rolled out tougher security measures and pledged aid for businesses after cost-of-living protests degenerated into violence, vandalism and looting. Bloomberg's Rosalind Mathieson has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Mynt’s Record IPO Brings a New Heavyweight to Philippine Stocks
top_news.summary: Shares of Mynt Inc. are set to make their debut Tuesday after the biggest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines, potentially giving global investors a new bet in a market they have ignored for years.

top_news.title: Amazon Rallies as Morgan Stanley Sees Major AI Upside | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Bailey Lipschultz, Carol Massar and Norah Mulinda. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: New Zealand’s Year-End Inflation Surge Points to More Rate Hikes
top_news.summary: New Zealand inflation likely eased slightly in the third quarter, but the respite is set to be short-lived as a weaker currency and surging oil prices drive an acceleration in the final three months of the year, building the case for rate hikes.

top_news.title: Citgo Raises Profit Outlook by $2 Billion as Fuel Margins Surge
top_news.summary: Citgo Petroleum Corp., the Venezuelan-owned, US-based refiner, has raised its 2026 operating profit outlook by $2 billion because of surging fuel margins, according to a document seen by Bloomberg News.

top_news.title: Bond Sale Tied to Manhattan Office Building Is Latest On Hold
top_news.summary: A bond sale tied to a 24-story office tower in midtown Manhattan that’s home to the publisher of Rolling Stone was postponed, the latest in a string of real estate-backed debt deals to be delayed in the face of weakened credit conditions and volatile rate markets.

top_news.title: Nasdaq 100 Climbs on AI Trade Revival After Rout: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A rebound in chipmakers buoyed the stock market as dip buyers emerged on bets the artificial-intelligence investment boom will continue to support solid earnings.

top_news.title: Secretary Wright on Diesel Shortage, Gas Prices, Oil Shipping
top_news.summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright talks about the sharp rise in diesel and gasoline prices and what the Trump administration is doing to bring them down. He also talks about converting dark fleet ships into legitimate oil tankers. He speaks to Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern at a Citadel Securities event in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: ASX Chief Says Australia Risks Falling Behind Asian Finance Hubs
top_news.summary: Australia risks losing more ground to major Asia Pacific financial centers unless its stock exchange upgrades its market and makes it easier for investors to access, according to ASX Ltd.’s new chief.

top_news.title: BMO Taps Bapoo as Critical Minerals Head in Florida Push
top_news.summary: BMO Capital Markets has appointed Rahim Bapoo to lead its global critical minerals strategy and help expand the investment bank’s presence in Florida to meet growing client demand across the value chain.
